# Conservative novelty statement

The paper does not claim novelty for staples, local action minimization,
smearing/flow, Riemannian centers of mass, Gaussian projections, constrained
least squares, or KKT systems.

The candidate contribution is their specific synthesis:

1. interpreting the gauge-invariant Fréchet dispersion of complementary
   transports as the exact residual geodesic-quadratic energy after optimizing
   the shared link;
2. evaluating the correctly oriented and centered dependent-Gaussian star law
   exactly on the open side-two four-cube; and
3. defining the minimum external-curvature lift form and proving, with exact
   rational certificates for all eight interior links, that it is positive
   definite with spectrum `37/33 (x3), 391/239 (x2)`.

Database searches found no direct match for “staple dispersion” or a Fréchet
mean of lattice-gauge staples.  Absence of a search hit is not proof of
novelty.  Submission remains on hold until an expert follows citation chains
in lattice update/smoothing and discrete Hodge literatures.
